#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

#define ll long long

#define inf -10000000000LL

void solve(){
    int n,q;
    cin >> n >> q;
    vector<int> v(n);
    vector<int> p(n);
    for(int i = 0;i < n;i++){
        int a;
        cin >> a;
        v[i] = a;
        a--;
        p[a] = i+1;
    }
    /*for(auto it:v){
        cout << it << " ";
    }
    cout << endl;
    for(auto it : p){
        cout << it <<" ";
    }
    cout << endl;*/
    while(q--){
        int a;
        cin >> a;
        if(a == 1){
            int b,c;
            cin >> b >> c;
            b--;c--;
            swap(v[b],v[c]);
            //cout << v[b]<<" "<<v[c];
            //cout << endl;
            //cout << p[--v[b]] << " "<<p[--v[c]];
            int z = v[b];
            int y = v[c];
            z--;y--;
            swap(p[z],p[y]);
            //cout << p[b]<<" "<<p[c];
            
            /*for(auto it:v){
            cout << it << " ";
            }
            cout << endl;
            for(auto it : p){
            cout << it <<" ";
            }*/
        }else{
            //vector<int> temp;
            //vector<pair<int,int>>p(n);
            /*for(auto &it:v){
                swap(it.first,it.second);
            }
            sort(v.begin(),v.end());
            */
           swap(v,p);
        }   
    }  
    for(auto it:v){
        cout << it<<" ";
    }cout << endl;
}
int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    ll tt = 1;
    //cin >> tt;
    while(tt--){
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}
